items.t: Bernstein Downgrades Devon Energy to Market Perform, Lowers Price Target to $44
items.sum: Bernstein analyst Bob Brackett downgrades Devon Energy (NYSE:DVN) from Outperform to Market Perform and lowers the price target from $49 to $44.

items.t: Devon Energy Q3 Earnings Call Highlights Permian Focus and Buybacks
items.sum: DVN's Q3 2026 earnings call highlights Permian expansion, higher merger synergies, accelerated buybacks and a disciplined 2027 capital spending plan.

items.t: UBS Maintains Buy on Devon Energy, Lowers Price Target to $62
items.sum: UBS analyst Josh Silverstein maintains Devon Energy (NYSE:DVN) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $65 to $62.

items.t: Devon Energy (DVN) Loses 13.4% in 4 Weeks, Here's Why a Trend Reversal May be Around the Corner
items.sum: The heavy selling pressure might have exhausted for Devon Energy (DVN) as it is technically in oversold territory now. In addition to this technical measure, strong agreement among Wall Street analysts in revising earnings estimates higher indicates that the stock is ripe for a trend reversal.
